name: EH3D-COMPONENT-INTELLIGENCE
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: early code. Technical database of electronic components in which every value carries its provenance: a Rust library and command line that read a JSON database, find duplicate identities, observations without a source, sources that disagree, records marked verified while something is pending and records without a recorded origin or licence, and refuse to export data without a licence. It has only run on data made by its own tests; the storage form, the import formats and the link with the symbols and footprints of the design tool are not decided.
